name: Evidence review
description: Review connected input. Separate observed facts, assumptions and missing evidence. Cite available source identifiers and recommend a concrete next action.

name: Acceptance criteria review
description: Assess supplied stories for clear actors, observable acceptance criteria, boundaries and missing rules. Propose testable wording without inventing requirements.

name: Risk-based test design
description: Derive a small prioritized set of scenarios from connected requirements and evidence. Include preconditions, data, actions, expected outcomes and traceability. Identify unsupported details as gaps.

name: User outcome
description: Focused Stories for a user goal and measurable result.
test_format: Actor, goal, business value and observable acceptance

name: Business workflow
description: Reviewable workflow slices with roles, decisions and outcomes.
test_format: Workflow slice with business rules and acceptance

name: API and integration
description: Stories for evidenced service behavior and data exchange.
test_format: Service outcome, contract boundaries and acceptance

name: Quality improvement
description: A bounded reliability, accessibility or usability improvement.
test_format: Observed problem, desired outcome and measurable acceptance

name: Clarify acceptance
description: Refine the current Story into clear, testable outcomes.
test_format: One refined Story with observable acceptance

name: Clarify workflow and scope
description: Make the current Story's flow and boundaries explicit.
test_format: One refined Story with clear flow and boundaries

name: Risk based regression pack
description: Broad regression coverage for a mature business workflow.
test_type: Regression, negative, boundary, and data validation
test_format: Manual test cases with clear preconditions, test data, steps, and expected results

name: Auth and access control
description: Authentication, authorization, account recovery, and session behavior.
test_type: Positive, negative, abuse, session, and permission tests
test_format: Concise executable cases grouped by user role and risk

name: Mobile critical path
description: Android/iOS friendly cases with device, permission, and interruption thinking.
test_type: Functional, interruption, permission, and device compatibility
test_format: Mobile-ready manual cases using android/ios step types when helpful
